error.denied: This account isn't registered as an adult in this family. Ask your family to invite you.

notice.changed: Something changed. Please check the new details.
notice.refused: That couldn't be done. The screen has been refreshed.
notice.expired: The demo session expired. Please restart.
notice.uncertain: We couldn't confirm whether it was sent (the connection dropped). “Send again” checks it as the same action.
notice.heldByOther: Someone else is in charge of this task. Please check with them.

today.title: Today
today.nothingBody: When a notice arrives, it shows up here.

decide.label: To decide
decide.title: {{date}}: {{what}}
decide.body: What about {{child}}? To go with “{{option}}”, decide by about {{deadline}} (estimate).
decide.conditional: Needed only if the notice's condition holds (not settled yet).
decide.turnedDown: The person you asked said no. Please pick another option.

family.label: For the family to decide
family.ifConditional: If {{value}}: depending on other conditions in the notice, {{maybe}}
family.ifBoth: If {{value}}: {{needs}}; depending on other conditions in the notice, {{maybe}}
family.ifNothing: If {{value}}: no tasks needed because of this answer
family.previous: You answered “{{value}}” before, but the reading of the notice has been corrected since. Please decide again.
family.hidden: Until you decide, related tasks won't be listed for someone to take on.

proposal.label: A request for you
proposal.where: {{place}} · about {{walk}} min walk from the station (estimate)
proposal.home: Home at {{time}} ({{late}} min later than usual)
proposal.changed: This changed after you accepted. Please check it again.
proposal.unplaced: Your usual schedule has no time for this before the deadline. If you can't do it, please ask someone else.
proposal.unplacedDue: Your usual schedule has no time left before the due date. If it's already done, tap Done.
proposal.conflicted: We couldn't find a time for this that doesn't overlap another task the same person is doing for an option in progress, so no time is set yet.
proposal.review: Review the options, who does them, or the times
proposal.handoff: Someone else does the step before or after this one, so we can't tell when the papers change hands. No time is set. Have one person do both steps, or agree on the handoff together.

external.reply: Ask {{to}} and wait for their reply.
external.approval: Hand it to {{to}} and wait for approval.
external.acceptance: Hand it to {{to}} and wait for them to accept it.

proposal.doneAlready: If you’ve already done “{{what}}”, record it with “{{label}}”. If you only did the version from before the change, don’t press it.
proposal.sentAlready: “{{label}}” opens the current request. If you already sent that same request, record it as sent there.
proposal.fixedBusy: Your usual schedule (work, etc.) or another task overlaps the written time. If you can't do it, please ask someone else.
proposal.fixedPast: The written time has passed. If it's done, tap Done.

backup.label: Just in case
backup.title: Also hold “{{option}}” as a backup?
backup.body: The deadline to sign up is about {{deadline}} (estimate).
backup.note: It shows up on their screen. They decide whether to take it.

cancel.label: No longer needed
cancel.body: Plans changed. Please tell them it's cancelled.
cancel.checkDate: There's no record of the date you asked for. Please check the date before sending.

check.label: Please check
check.title: Is your request to {{to}} still needed?
check.body: Something it relied on has changed (the notice changed or was deleted). You decide whether to cancel.

change.label: What changed
change.from: A notice received on {{date}} changed the following.

gone.childCare: Childcare on {{date}} ({{what}}) is no longer needed

unowned.label: No one is doing this yet

stuck.noStore: It's needed by {{date}}, but we couldn't tell which store sells it, so no time to buy it was planned. If you get it another way, tap "Got it".
stuck.label: No way found in time
stuck.purchase: It's needed by {{date}}, but no time to buy it was found on your registered routes and stores. If you get it another way, tap "Got it".
stuck.childCare: No way was found to arrange {{child}} with your registered options and deadlines. Please think of another way together.

timing.dayUnconfirmed: {{day}} (please check the time in the original text)
timing.undatedUnconfirmed: Please check the date and time in the original text

escort.estimate: {{from}}–{{to}} is an estimate (a 30-minute trip each way; the route is not checked)
escort.rule: From {{child}}'s drop-off and pick-up rule (assuming they go)
escort.stated: You said it is needed this time
escort.dateUnknown: Pick-up for the event on {{day}}. Please check the pick-up date and time in the original text

released.label: No longer needed
released.when: You had agreed to do it {{when}}.
released.body: You took this on, but a notice or a family answer has changed and it is no longer needed. Please check before you head out.
released.unknown: A task you took on (no record of what it was)
released.inactive: You took this on, but the family chose another way (or the main plan was confirmed), so this step will not go ahead. Please check before you head out.
released.check: A task you took on is no longer in the plan (for example, its notice was deleted). Please check whether it is still needed.

quiet.bringAtHome: You answered that it's at home.
quiet.bringMissingLate: You answered that it's not at home. The preparation deadline has passed, so it's up to the family what to do.

decide.title: What about {{child}}?
decide.source: See when and why in the original text

because.onlyOption: This is the only option known to still be in time
because.lowerCost: Lightest overall when leave, asking others, cost and extra tasks are combined with rough weights
because.moreTime: Of the options with the same estimated burden, it leaves the most time to decide

then.label: If you choose this
then.cancel: A task to tell {{to}} the request is cancelled will appear
then.moved_one: {{count}} other task moves so times do not overlap
then.moved_other: {{count}} other tasks move so times do not overlap
then.overlap: This would overlap another task; both cannot be placed (one of them needs to change)
then.issues_one: The plan has {{count}} point that needs checking
then.issues_other: The plan has {{count}} points that need checking
then.conflict: We can't find times for the tasks of {{options}} that don't overlap other tasks your family is doing, so they stay without a time (review the options, who does them, or the times)
then.handOver: It no longer fits your time. Choosing proposes the tasks to {{name}}
then.later: {{name}} could still make it if they start by {{when}}
then.released: “{{what}}”, which {{name}} took on, will no longer be needed (they will be told)
then.releasedYou: “{{what}}”, which you took on, will no longer be needed

decide.reversible: You can change this later. If you do, Maniau shows what needs cancelling or asking again as tasks (your family does the contacting).
decide.conflicted: We couldn't find times for the tasks of {{options}} that don't overlap another task the same person is doing, so they have no time yet. Review the options, who does them, or the times.
decide.replyBy: If you hear back by the evening of {{night}}, you can still switch to “{{fallback}}” if they say no
decide.replySoon: The decision deadline for “{{fallback}}” is around {{deadline}} (estimate), so try to hear back as soon as you can

waiting.loading: Working out what would happen. You can choose once it shows.
waiting.failed: What would happen isn't shown yet, so you can't choose this yet.
waiting.missing: We couldn't work out what would happen for this option, so it can't be chosen now.

decide.previewFailed: Couldn't load what would happen. Load it again before choosing.

ask.title: Send this message
ask.body: Send it by LINE or similar. {{name}} doesn't need this app.
ask.editable: You can edit it before sending.
ask.pasteToSend: The message is copied. Paste it into LINE or another app to send it.
ask.copyFailed: Copying isn't available on this device. Press and hold the message above to select and copy it.
ask.next1: When they reply, tap “They said OK” here.
ask.next2: If there's no reply, the backup option shows on Today about a day before its deadline.

sources.title: Notices
sources.snapBody: Photograph school handouts or the contact notebook and they appear here (in the demo, you can see the notices that arrived).
sources.fromPhoto: Transcribed from a photo (the photo isn't kept).
sources.check_one: Please check {{count}} sentence (not read, not matching the original, or readable two ways).
sources.check_other: Please check {{count}} sentences (not read, not matching the original, or readable two ways).
sources.checkAll: Part of the reading couldn't be tied to a sentence. Please check the whole notice.

escortOn.to: Drop-off is needed (marked not needed this time)
escortOn.from: Pick-up is needed (marked not needed this time)

gakudoForm.write: Fill in the after-school care form
gakudoForm.submit: Hand in the after-school care form

push.install: Add to Home Screen to get notifications
push.denied: Notifications are off in your device settings

input.label: Add a notice
input.help: Paste a notice from school or an activity, or speak it with your keyboard's microphone. Anything that can be planned becomes decisions and deadlines. What each sentence became is shown next to the original.
input.placeholder: e.g. Monday 12/7 is a normal school day. The presentation is postponed to Tuesday 12/8.
input.photoPrivacy: Photos and PDFs are sent to Anthropic's Claude API to estimate their size and to be transcribed. This app doesn't keep them. Try one that shows no names or places.
input.pdfNote: Transcribed from the PDF. Open the PDF to compare, fix anything that differs, then press "Read it".
input.tooLong: The text is too long ({{count}} characters; up to {{max}}). Delete what isn't needed, then press "Read it".
input.photoNote: Transcribed from the photo. Compare it with the photo, fix anything that differs, then press "Read it".

photoStatus.empty: No text could be read. Retake the photo in good light with the whole notice in frame.
photoStatus.tooLarge: Too large or too many pages (one photo, or a PDF of a few pages up to 4 MB). Keep only the pages you need.
photoStatus.unsupported: This format can't be opened. Choose a photo (JPEG, PNG, etc.) or a PDF.
photoStatus.unreadable: The file couldn't be read. Save it to your device, then choose it again.
photoStatus.limit: No transcriptions left. For this demo, use "Restart" for a new demo. The server-wide limit resets the next day (UTC).
photoStatus.busy: Another reading is in progress. Please wait a moment, then press "Send again".
photoStatus.uncertain: No answer came back. Press "Send again" (if it was already transcribed, it won't be read again; nothing was recorded).
photoStatus.failed: It couldn't be transcribed. Press "Send again", retake the photo, or paste the text.

input.privacy: What you enter is sent to Anthropic's Claude API to be read (to understand changes, items already read in this demo are sent too). Use made-up text, or remove anything that identifies a person or place (names, school names, addresses). In this demo the text is kept only in the server's memory, and demos left unused for more than 12 hours are deleted periodically.
input.limit: No readings left. For this demo, use "Restart" for a new demo. The server-wide limit resets the next day (UTC).
input.busy: Another reading is in progress. Please wait a moment and press again.
input.uncertain: No answer came back. Press again to check the previous reading (if it was added, it won't be added twice; if it wasn't read, it will be read again).
input.failed: It couldn't be read. Please check the text and try again.
input.clock: Words like “tomorrow” are read against the demo clock ({{now}}).
input.stale: While reading, items read earlier changed (corrected, confirmed, etc.). Please press "Read it" again. Your text is still here.

say.label: Quick update
say.privacy: Your update and this demo's plan and (fictional) names are sent to Anthropic. Don't include anything that identifies a person or place (names, school names, addresses).
say.which: Which one do you mean? The one you tap is recorded.
say.whichUnknown: We couldn't tell which one you mean. Please say it again with the date or the person.
say.lookAlike: Some matches look the same, so they aren't offered. Please say it again with the date, time, or person.
say.sameTarget: Another notice asks for the same item on the same day, so we can't tell which one this answers. On Today, check which notice each card comes from and answer there.
say.sameTask: Another task has the same name on the same day, so we can't tell which one to record. On Today, check which notice each card comes from and record it there.
say.unknownRequest: a request whose content is unknown
say.otherAdult: This looks like another adult's task. That person records changes such as not being able to do it or having done it.
say.unowned: One of these tasks has no one assigned yet. Choose who does it on the Today card first.

unsupported.routineChange: Changes to the usual week (pickups, work) can't be recorded yet.
unsupported.otherAdultsTask: This looks like another adult's task. That person records it.
unsupported.notInPlan: Nothing in the plan matches this.
unsupported.other: This update can't be recorded yet.

say.answer: Here is what the plan shows.

do.withdraw: Record that you can no longer do: {{what}}
do.withdraw_dated: Record that you can no longer do: {{what}} ({{date}})
do.cancelSent: Record that you told {{name}} it is cancelled
do.cancelSent_dated: Record that you told {{name}} it is cancelled (for {{date}})

say.changed: This changed after it was shown, so nothing was recorded. Check the current screen and send your update again.
say.gone: This suggestion is out of date. Please send your update again.
say.uncertain: No response arrived. Tap again to resend it as the same action.
say.limit: This demo has used all its readings. Use Restart to start a new demo.
say.busy: Still reading. Please wait a moment.
say.failed: This could not be read. Please send it again.
say.stale: The plan changed while reading. Tap Send again.
say.pending: An earlier action may not have arrived. Check the message at the top of the screen, then tap again.
say.needsCheck: check whether it is still needed
say.outdated: The plan changed, so the earlier answer was closed. Please send your update again.

clock.label: Until each choice disappears
clock.none: No choice is left before its decision deadline
clock.unknownOnly_one: No option with a known deadline is left. {{count}} option has an unknown deadline
clock.unknownOnly_other: No option with a known deadline is left. {{count}} options have an unknown deadline
clock.show: See the time left for each option
